meta.title: Jujutsu (jj) tools
meta.description: jj-native model tools (aligned with host sandboxPolicy and approval boundaries): status, log, diff, new, commit, describe, commit-style detection, squash, amend (fold a correction into an unpushed commit), abandon (drop unpublished revisions), undo/op log/op restore, fetch, workspace create/enter/restore/list and stale recovery, bookmark, rebase, plus a one-call hand-off integration (with cross-workspace rewrite protection) and cleanup of temporary or interrupted-session workspaces.
